name: GoalMeter - The 2026 Goal Before Launch
description: The band as /donate renders it today: no Givebutter widget id, so the component draws its own bar from the committed figures. Unlike its widget-mode siblings it needs no harness override to be visible, so this frame is what a visitor sees. The numbers are real as of 2026-09-14 — nothing raised against a 2026 goal of $10,000 — and they replaced $20 of $100,000, which was invented.
